messages.text: I closed the card I paid with yesterday. Can this refund be sent to my new card instead?

I’m afraid the refund can’t be redirected to a different card; it is recorded against the order’s original payment. The card issuer handles any credit to a closed card, and the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).
